annotations.title: Recent Form 4/A amendments and what each corrected (SEC Form 4/A)

description: Use when the user asks which insider filings were amended, corrected, or restated, or wants recent Form 4/A amendments. Returns 4/A amendments, newest-filed first; `ticker`, `issuer_name`, `person`, `start`/`end`, `days` narrow. Each row carries the amendment_accession, filed_date, issuer/insider, source filing_url, the original_accession it amends (when collected), and `changed_fields` (before/after). Caveat: when the original is not collected the amendment is still listed with original_in_corpus=false and before/after null (never guessed); linkage is by issuer/owner/period.

as_of.description: Publish-boundary replay: UTC ISO-8601 instant (or a bare YYYY-MM-DD, read as end-of-day UTC). Returns only rows that had crossed the publish boundary at or before it — the exact feed visible at that past moment. Each row carries `first_served_at` (null on rows published before the stamp existed; those are kept, as they were already public).

days.description: Only amendments filed within the last N days.

end.description: Only amendments filed on/before this ISO date

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, newest first). Page with offset; the response's total_matched shows the full count. limit<=0 = no cap.

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page (pagination). Default 0.

start.description: Only amendments filed on/after this ISO date

ticker.description: Filter to one issuer ticker (case-insensitive substring), e.g. GLBZ
